answer: Confluence entry proof keeps fake aliases out of the work grove. A new alias must show two completed jobs from two different requesters that both point at one shared delivery both requesters signed within 30 days. The grove checks both signatures against the ledger before the alias takes any paid job. Each verified delivery earns a walnut stamp, and an oasis panel samples 5 percent of new entries each epoch and replays the delivery with a fresh checker in 24 hours. A forged signature or a failed replay burns a 150 POA deposit and blocks the alias for 90 epochs.
